notes: Both 'Kralcılar' (Royalists/King's Men) and 'Sadıklar' (The Loyal Ones) appear in .po files. 'Kralcılar' is the correct canonical form: it is used in the core wesnoth-multiplayer domain for the standalone faction label, faction description, and scenario map labels — all official multiplayer UI strings. 'Sadıklar' appears only in (1) the World Conquest add-on campaign (wesnoth-wc domain, a different translator) and (2) a music track name in the wesnoth domain, where 'Loyalists' is a music piece title, not a faction label. Semantically, 'Kralcılar' better fits the in-game lore: the Loyalists are explicitly soldiers loyal to the throne of Wesnoth ('loyal to the throne'), making the royalist/king's-men sense more accurate than the abstract 'Sadıklar' (loyal ones). Use 'Sadıklar' only for the music track title if preserving historical translation; all faction label and gameplay UI contexts should use 'Kralcılar'.
